guidance.statement: Next year, we are targeting almost INR56,000 crores without the Vivo numbers, and mobile volume being flat.
Smartphone volumes expected to grow 20-25% QoQ in Q2FY27 on an order book of 9-9.2 million units
Telecom segment revenue guided to ₹6,700-7,000 Cr in FY27
No margin improvement expected in the current year; margins should start to improve next year
PLI 2 export volumes from two anchor customers could add ₹18,000-20,000 Cr of revenue in a couple of years
Vivo JV transaction to conclude within two months and revenue to be accounted from Q3FY27

entities.name: Kunshan Q Tech Microelectronics (India) Private Limited

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Durables > Consumer Electronics

operating_notes.text: GST penalty of ₹0.16 Cr imposed by Uttarakhand authorities due to delivery challan and E-way bill mismatches.

A subsidiary recognised PLI incentive income with a corresponding pass-through liability outstanding at 31 March 2026; formal determination and disbursement by the Project Management Agency were pending.
FY26 cash from operations of ₹1,782.29 Cr was 108% of net profit of ₹1,644.25 Cr, with capex of ₹1,067.51 Cr.
Q4FY26 revenues impacted by geopolitical concerns, softer consumer demand, and inventory rationalization.
Smartphone exports were about ₹1,100 Cr in the quarter, roughly 0.6-0.7 million units.
Telecom segment operating margin was about 5.1% in Q1FY27; IT hardware margin is slightly lower, similar to mobile.
Q Tech camera module capacity being expanded from 70 million to 180-190 million units annually over 15-18 months.

Dixon Technologies (India) Limited’s Ashish Kumar, President-Chief Legal Counsel & Group Company Secretary, uploaded Q4 FY2026 conference call recording on 12 May 2026.

Dixon Technologies (India) Limited’s **Ashish Kumar** (President-Chief Legal Counsel & Group Company Secretary) informed exchanges of one-on-one investor meetings with **Ellerston Capital** (May 14, 10:45 AM IST, virtual) and **Invesco MF** (May 14, 11:45 AM IST, in-person) under SEBI LODR.
Dixon Technologies reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹10,520 Cr and outlined strong capacity expansion plans across segments.

Dixon Technologies (India) Limited’s **Ashish Kumar** held one-on-one investor meets with **TATA MF** and **Buoyant Capital** on 15th May 2026, virtually and in-person respectively, sharing no unpublished price-sensitive information.

Dixon Technologies (India) Limited’s **Ashish Kumar** (President-Chief Legal Counsel & Group Company Secretary) held a one-on-one virtual meeting with **Principal Global Asset Management** on June 1, 2026, at 6:15 PM IST.
